title: Domestic violence perpetrators are using smart car features to abuse, researchers warn
summary_full: Exclusive: Alarming report reveals how tracking and monitoring functions and digital key access have been used to facilitate abuseGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastEarlier this year a man in Australia was found guilty of using a connected car app to harass his former partner, including restricting the speed at which she could drive, sometimes to 40km an hour.In 2022 in the US, a woman found her former husband had used a car app associated with her car to track her; the carmaker then allegedly refused to terminate the former partner’s digital access to the vehicle.
